items.title: Amazon and Meta Explore Deal Onboard Muse AI Shopping Agent to Amazon Shopping - Techweez
items.zh_title: 亚马逊与 Meta 洽谈合作，拟将 Muse AI 购物助手接入亚马逊购物
items.zh_oneliner: 亚马逊与 Meta 正在洽谈合作，计划把 Muse AI 购物助手引入亚马逊购物，让用户在选购时直接调用 AI 助手帮忙。
items.en_oneliner: Amazon and Meta are reportedly in talks to bring the Muse AI shopping agent to Amazon Shopping, letting shoppers call on the AI assistant for help while they browse and buy.
items.source: Google 新闻：Muse AI assistant（英文）

items.title: EasyJet allows Meta’s Muse AI agent to make flight bookings amid mixed airline reactions - FlightGlobal
items.zh_title: 易捷航空允许Meta Muse AI助手代订机票，航空业反应不一
items.zh_oneliner: 易捷航空已允许Meta的Muse AI助手为用户预订机票，航空业对此态度各异。
items.en_oneliner: EasyJet now lets Meta's Muse AI assistant book flights for users, while reactions across the airline industry remain mixed.
items.source: Google 新闻：Muse Meta AI（英文）
items.reason_en: Published within 6 hours · Related to this topic
